paper_cards.title: World Models
paper_cards.problem: How to learn compact spatial and temporal representations of game environments so that agents can train with fewer direct environment interactions.
paper_cards.method: A variational autoencoder compresses observations, an MDN-RNN predicts latent dynamics, and a compact controller is optimized in latent space.
paper_cards.contribution: The paper showed that agents can be trained inside learned models of game environments such as CarRacing and VizDoom.
paper_cards.limitations: The demonstrations use relatively simple environments, and accumulated rollout error can weaken long-horizon planning.
paper_cards.abstract: World Models introduced a compact latent-dynamics approach for training agents in learned game environments.

key_results.text: The paper showed that agents can be trained inside learned models of game environments such as CarRacing and VizDoom.

method.text: A variational autoencoder compresses observations, an MDN-RNN predicts latent dynamics, and a compact controller is optimized in latent space.

limitations.text: The demonstrations use relatively simple environments, and accumulated rollout error can weaken long-horizon planning.

paper_cards.title: DreamerV3: Mastering Diverse Domains through World Models
paper_cards.category: Planning and Control with Learned Models
paper_cards.problem: How to make world-model reinforcement learning robust across diverse domains with minimal task-specific tuning.
paper_cards.method: DreamerV3 learns a latent world model and trains actor-critic behavior from imagined trajectories.
paper_cards.contribution: It broadened the empirical case for world-model agents across visual control and game-like domains.
paper_cards.limitations: The approach still depends on learned model quality and careful evaluation across domains.
paper_cards.abstract: DreamerV3 studies scalable latent world models for general reinforcement learning.

key_results.text: It broadened the empirical case for world-model agents across visual control and game-like domains.

method.text: DreamerV3 learns a latent world model and trains actor-critic behavior from imagined trajectories.

limitations.text: The approach still depends on learned model quality and careful evaluation across domains.

paper_cards.title: Mastering Atari, Go, Chess and Shogi by Planning with a Learned Model
paper_cards.category: Planning and Control with Learned Models
paper_cards.problem: How to combine planning with learned dynamics without requiring a hand-coded simulator model.
paper_cards.method: MuZero learns representation, dynamics, and prediction functions and uses tree search over the learned model.
paper_cards.contribution: The system achieved strong results in Atari and classic board games while learning the model used for planning.
paper_cards.limitations: The planning machinery and training pipeline are computationally demanding.
paper_cards.abstract: MuZero demonstrates planning over learned latent dynamics for games and control tasks.

key_results.text: The system achieved strong results in Atari and classic board games while learning the model used for planning.

method.text: MuZero learns representation, dynamics, and prediction functions and uses tree search over the learned model.

limitations.text: The planning machinery and training pipeline are computationally demanding.

paper_cards.title: GameNGen: Diffusion Models Are Real-Time Game Engines
paper_cards.category: Neural Game Engines and Interactive Environments
paper_cards.problem: How to generate interactive game frames in real time using learned generative dynamics.
paper_cards.method: The system uses a diffusion model conditioned on previous frames and actions to produce playable game-video dynamics.
paper_cards.contribution: It framed diffusion models as neural game engines capable of interactive visual simulation.
paper_cards.limitations: Real-time generative play raises consistency, controllability, and evaluation challenges.
paper_cards.abstract: GameNGen explores diffusion models as real-time neural game engines.

key_results.text: It framed diffusion models as neural game engines capable of interactive visual simulation.

method.text: The system uses a diffusion model conditioned on previous frames and actions to produce playable game-video dynamics.

limitations.text: Real-time generative play raises consistency, controllability, and evaluation challenges.

paper_cards.title: Genie: Generative Interactive Environments
paper_cards.category: Neural Game Engines and Interactive Environments
paper_cards.problem: How to learn action-controllable interactive environments from video-scale data.
paper_cards.method: Genie learns a latent action model and video generator to create controllable environments from visual examples.
paper_cards.contribution: It connected generative video modeling with interactive environment construction for agents and players.
paper_cards.limitations: Generated environments require careful evaluation of controllability, temporal coherence, and task semantics.
paper_cards.abstract: Genie presents a foundation world model for generative interactive environments.

key_results.text: It connected generative video modeling with interactive environment construction for agents and players.

method.text: Genie learns a latent action model and video generator to create controllable environments from visual examples.

limitations.text: Generated environments require careful evaluation of controllability, temporal coherence, and task semantics.

paper_cards.title: Grandmaster Level in StarCraft II Using Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
paper_cards.category: Game Agents and Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
paper_cards.problem: How to train agents for a complex real-time strategy game with partial observability and long-horizon decisions.
paper_cards.method: AlphaStar combines supervised learning, reinforcement learning, and league-based multi-agent training.
paper_cards.contribution: The work demonstrated grandmaster-level performance in StarCraft II and highlighted the value of competitive training ecosystems.
paper_cards.limitations: The system relies on extensive engineering, training scale, and domain-specific interfaces.
paper_cards.abstract: AlphaStar studies large-scale multi-agent reinforcement learning for StarCraft II.

key_results.text: The work demonstrated grandmaster-level performance in StarCraft II and highlighted the value of competitive training ecosystems.

method.text: AlphaStar combines supervised learning, reinforcement learning, and league-based multi-agent training.

limitations.text: The system relies on extensive engineering, training scale, and domain-specific interfaces.

paper_cards.title: Dota 2 with Large Scale Deep Reinforcement Learning
paper_cards.category: Game Agents and Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
paper_cards.problem: How to train coordinated agents in a high-dimensional, long-horizon multiplayer game.
paper_cards.method: OpenAI Five uses large-scale self-play reinforcement learning with recurrent policies and extensive distributed training.
paper_cards.contribution: The project showed that self-play can produce strong coordinated behavior in Dota 2.
paper_cards.limitations: The training regime is compute-intensive and tied to a specific game abstraction.
paper_cards.abstract: OpenAI Five demonstrates large-scale reinforcement learning in Dota 2.

key_results.text: The project showed that self-play can produce strong coordinated behavior in Dota 2.

method.text: OpenAI Five uses large-scale self-play reinforcement learning with recurrent policies and extensive distributed training.

limitations.text: The training regime is compute-intensive and tied to a specific game abstraction.

paper_cards.title: Generative Agents: Interactive Simulacra of Human Behavior
paper_cards.category: Open-Ended Simulators and Game Intelligence Benchmarks
paper_cards.problem: How to create believable interactive agents that remember, plan, and act in a simulated social environment.
paper_cards.method: The system combines memory streams, reflection, planning, and language-model-driven action selection.
paper_cards.contribution: It illustrated how generative agents can populate interactive worlds with coherent behavior.
paper_cards.limitations: Behavioral realism and evaluation remain difficult, and language-model outputs need guardrails.
paper_cards.abstract: Generative Agents studies language-model-based agents in an interactive sandbox world.

key_results.text: It illustrated how generative agents can populate interactive worlds with coherent behavior.

method.text: The system combines memory streams, reflection, planning, and language-model-driven action selection.

limitations.text: Behavioral realism and evaluation remain difficult, and language-model outputs need guardrails.

paper_cards.title: UniSim: Learning Interactive Real-World Simulators
paper_cards.category: Open-Ended Simulators and Game Intelligence Benchmarks
paper_cards.problem: How to learn interactive simulators that can support agents beyond a single fixed task.
paper_cards.method: UniSim trains generative world simulators from broad visual interaction data.
paper_cards.contribution: It positions learned simulators as reusable environments for interactive intelligence.
paper_cards.limitations: General-purpose simulator quality depends on broad data coverage and robust interaction evaluation.
paper_cards.abstract: UniSim explores learning interactive simulators from data.

key_results.text: It positions learned simulators as reusable environments for interactive intelligence.

method.text: UniSim trains generative world simulators from broad visual interaction data.

limitations.text: General-purpose simulator quality depends on broad data coverage and robust interaction evaluation.

paper_cards.title: Diffusion World Models
paper_cards.problem: How to use diffusion-style generative modeling for world dynamics and agent learning.
paper_cards.method: The work uses diffusion models to represent or predict environment dynamics for model-based learning.
paper_cards.contribution: It expands the design space of generative world models beyond recurrent latent dynamics.
paper_cards.limitations: Diffusion rollouts can be expensive and must be assessed for temporal consistency.
paper_cards.abstract: Diffusion World Models investigates diffusion-based dynamics for world-model learning.

key_results.text: It expands the design space of generative world models beyond recurrent latent dynamics.

method.text: The work uses diffusion models to represent or predict environment dynamics for model-based learning.

paper_cards.title: GAIA-1: A Generative World Model for Autonomous Driving
paper_cards.problem: How to learn a controllable generative world model for complex embodied environments.
paper_cards.method: GAIA-1 models video, action, and scene context to generate plausible future driving observations.
paper_cards.contribution: Although outside games, it shows how controllable world models can transfer to high-stakes embodied simulation.
paper_cards.limitations: Driving-focused results do not directly solve game intelligence evaluation and require domain-specific validation.

paper_cards.title: MineDojo: Building Open-Ended Embodied Agents with Internet-Scale Knowledge
paper_cards.category: Open-Ended Simulators and Game Intelligence Benchmarks
paper_cards.problem: How to benchmark and train open-ended embodied agents in a rich game environment.
paper_cards.method: MineDojo builds a Minecraft-based environment with tasks, data, and knowledge resources.
paper_cards.contribution: It provides a large open-ended game environment for embodied agent research.
paper_cards.limitations: Minecraft-specific affordances and task design choices shape what can be concluded.
